newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai mulls share placement.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai mulls share placement.

text.p: Finance group First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Tuesday it was considering a placement of shares to raise funds for working capital.

"The company is currently exploring certain proposals, including placement of the company's shares, with a view to further enhancing its working capital, which may or may not materialise," director Felix Chow said in a company statement issued through the stock exchange.
Chow also advised shareholders to exercise caution in dealing in the company's shares.
The statement gave no further details.
First Shanghai shares were down HK$0.08 at HK$0.87 at midday on Tuesday on volume of 47.5 million shares.
